string-array.name: policy_sales_highlights
string-array.item: 10%% deposit
30-day storage
Invoice support
Change within 24 hours

string-array.name: policy_sales_paragraphs
string-array.item: For orders above 10,000,000 VND that are not fully paid before delivery, customers make a 10%% deposit. The remaining amount is paid when receiving the order.
If the customer cancels the order after placing a deposit, UniFurniture does not refund the 10%% deposit because the order has already been prepared.
If the remaining amount is not paid at delivery, UniFurniture may collect the products matching the unpaid value and charge a 300,000 VND delivery handling fee for free-delivery areas.
Any building management fees related to truck entry, elevators, loading areas, or similar delivery conditions are paid directly by the customer to the building management team.
If an invoice is needed, please notify UniFurniture when placing the order. Issued invoices cannot be edited, cancelled, or reissued with different information.
After 24 hours from order confirmation, the order can no longer be changed or cancelled once it has been packed and transferred to delivery.
Maximum storage time is 30 days from the order date. Storage longer than 7 days requires full payment before storage support continues.

string-array.name: policy_shipping_highlights
string-array.item: Delivery fee included
Within 3 working days
One reschedule allowed

string-array.name: policy_shipping_paragraphs
string-array.item: UniFurniture supports delivery and installation according to the confirmed order. Delivery cost is already included in the displayed product price, so customers do not pay an extra shipping fee.
Estimated delivery time is within 3 working days, from 9:00 to 16:00, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays and Tet.
Delivery and installation are supported in Ho Chi Minh City, Thu Duc City, Bien Hoa, Di An, Thuan An, Thu Dau Mot, Tan Uyen, and selected nearby areas.
For distant areas or locations outside the installation zone, UniFurniture can still support delivery but may not provide in-home installation.
Please arrange to receive the order within the confirmed time slot. If the schedule changes, notify UniFurniture at least 24 hours before delivery.
UniFurniture supports one delivery reschedule. From the next change, the company may refuse delivery or cancel the order depending on the actual case.

string-array.name: policy_warranty_highlights
string-array.item: 5-year warranty
Lifetime maintenance
Clear coverage
Office chair note

string-array.name: policy_warranty_paragraphs
string-array.item: The standard warranty period is 5 years from successful delivery, with lifetime maintenance support after the warranty period.
UniFurniture provides free warranty service for damage caused by material defects, technical defects, or installation errors from UniFurniture.
The warranty does not cover damage from natural disasters, self-transportation, self-installation, self-repair, incorrect use, natural wear, or discontinued clearance products.
Products outside warranty coverage or beyond the 5-year warranty period can still receive lifetime maintenance with a reasonable fee based on actual condition.
Office chairs have a 1-year warranty for the frame, base, and gas lift mechanism.

string-array.name: policy_return_highlights
string-array.item: Exchange within 3 days
Two conditions required
Excludes holidays
Check at delivery

string-array.name: policy_return_paragraphs
string-array.item: Within 3 days from successful delivery, excluding Sundays and public holidays, customers may exchange products for free when the required conditions are met.
Condition 1: the product is damaged due to material defects, technical defects, or installation errors from UniFurniture.
Condition 2: the exchange product has an equal or higher value than the delivered product.
After 3 days from successful delivery, UniFurniture applies the warranty policy for material, technical, and installation issues instead of product exchange.
Returns are only accepted at the delivery moment if the product does not match the order information, or if the customer ordered incorrectly and decides immediately.

string-array.name: policy_loyalty_highlights
string-array.item: 100,000 VND = 1 point
4 member tiers
Up to 7%% off
365-day expiry

string-array.name: policy_loyalty_paragraphs
string-array.item: U-HOMIE is the UniFurniture loyalty program. Every customer is considered a valued companion in the process of building a warmer home.
Points are earned at the rate of 100,000 VND for 1 point. Points are added automatically after an order is paid successfully.
When customers reach 20 points, equal to 2,000,000 VND in eligible spending, they become U-HOMIE loyalty members.
Member tiers include Bronze from 20 points, Silver from 50 points, Gold from 150 points, and Diamond from 500 points.
Eligible tier benefits include 3%% off for Silver, 5%% off for Gold, and 7%% off for Diamond on qualified orders.
Accumulated points expire after 365 days if no new successful order is created, or if generated orders are not delivered successfully.

string-array.name: policy_partner_highlights
string-array.item: Individuals and businesses
All UniFurniture products
Marketing support
Listed price compliance

string-array.name: policy_partner_paragraphs
string-array.item: The partner policy applies to individuals and businesses in many fields, including interior design, construction, retail, and service locations.
The policy covers UniFurniture branded products and areas within the current selling, delivery, and installation scope of UniFurniture.
Partners can receive support for delivery, installation, warranty, maintenance, product knowledge, communication materials, and display products depending on the program.
Partners must follow the listed selling price on the UniFurniture website and must not undercut or distort product pricing.
Partners are responsible for preserving display products and communication materials provided by UniFurniture, and for maintaining product quality in customer-facing spaces.
